modules.name: Daily question
modules.summary: Posts a conversation starter every day at a time you choose, and adds !question.
modules.description: Thirty friendly questions. One is posted each day at the time and in the channel you set (in every community the bot serves that has that channel), and anyone can ask for another with !question. Set the channel, time and time zone under Settings → Daily question.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: FAQ helper
modules.summary: !invite, !support and !links, plus answers to the questions newcomers always ask.
modules.description: Three commands whose text you set under Settings → FAQ helper, and two autoresponders that point people to them when they ask how to invite someone or where to get help.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: Server rules
modules.summary: A !rules command that shows your rules as a card, and a pointer when someone asks about them.
modules.description: Write your rules once in Settings → Server rules. !rules shows them as a card; when someone says "rules" in chat, the bot points them to the command (at most every two minutes per channel).
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: 8-ball, coins and dice
modules.summary: !8ball answers yes-or-no questions, !coin flips a coin and !dice rolls a die.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: Good vibes
modules.summary: Reacts to good mornings, thanks and congratulations, and adds !hug and !highfive.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: Vectoria
modules.summary: A talking pixel-art expert on Vector bots and WebXDC: !vec answers in text, !vectoria in a lip-synced video.
modules.description:
Vectoria knows the Vector SDKs (Python, Rust, JS) and WebXDC Mini Apps, and searches the web when her notes don't cover something. Ask with !vec for a text answer (code included), or !vectoria for a short video: her sprite lip-syncs to a retro SAM voice under a VHS filter, with C64-style subtitles. Reply to any of her answers to keep talking. She remembers each person (!vecmemory, !vecforget), and 👍/👎 votes are kept.

Needs: an Ollama API key (ollama.com, free tier works) in the bot's .env as OLLAMA_API_KEY, or a local Ollama. For videos: ffmpeg, plus her voice, which an owner builds once with !vecvoice (git and a C compiler). Without those she still answers in text. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord

modules.name: AI automod
modules.summary: An AI model reads each message against your rules and removes what breaks them.
modules.description: Uses any OpenAI-compatible API: a local Ollama or LM Studio, OpenAI, OpenRouter. Write your rules in plain words under Settings → AI automod. It does automod's job, so it switches Sentire off while it's on. Messages are sent to the address you set: use a local model if that matters to you. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code.
modules.author: lucky-edgelord
